UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order Under Section 25A

BY Virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I,A. Ibathul Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planinng, Water Supply and Higher Education, having obtained a report under section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respect of the Colombo International Nautical and Engineering College (Private) Limited, a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007 and bearing registration number PV 17745, do by this Order, amend the Schedule II to the Order made under the said act, and published in Gazette Extraordinary, No. 2067/15 of April 19, 2018, by the addition immediately after the entry “Bachelor of Education Honours in Information Technology” appearing in Column I and it’s corresponding entry in Column II thereof, of the entries specified under Column I and Column II respectively of the Schedule II hereto, subject to the conditions specified in Schedule I hereto. A. IBATHUL RAUFF HAKEEM, Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education. Colombo, 30th April 2019.
Schedule I
CONDITIONS

(i) The Bachelor of Science Honours in Industrial Pharmaceutical Sciences and the Bachelor of Science
Honours in Cosmetics Sciences, adhere to the minimum entry qualifications of- (a) Three (3) ‘simple passes’ (S) in Biological Science stream in one and the same sitting at the GCE
Advanced Level Examination or equivalent; or (b) Three (3) ‘simple passes’ (S) from among the subject stream of Physical Science, Engineering

Technology and Biosystems Technology in one and the same sitting at the GCE Advanced Level Examination with a foundation course approved by the Specified Authority. (ii) The Bachelor of Science Honours in Biomedical Sciences, adhere to the minimum entry qualification of three

(3) ‘simple passes’ (S) in Biological Science stream in one and the same sitting at the GCE Advanced Level Examination or equivalent. (iii) The Bachelor of Management Honours in Business Administration, the Bachelor of Management Honours

in Human Resource Management and the Bachelor of Management Honours in Industrial Management, adhere to the minimum entry qualification of- (a) Three (3) ‘simple passes’ (S) in Commerce stream in one and the same sitting at the GCE Advanced
Level Examination or equivalent ; or (b) Three (3) ‘simple passes’ (S) in any subject stream in one and the same sitting at the GCE Advanced
Level Examination with a foundation course approved by the Specified Authority. (iv) The Bachelor of Arts Honours in English, adhere to the minimum entry qualification of three (3) ‘simple
passes’ (S) in any subject stream with English as a subject in one and the same sitting at the GCE Advanced Level Examination or equivalent.
